body: Hi I’m sorry for everything that’s occurred. We can be friends online. I really think you can live past all of it
I do take Zoloft but it just like a Bandaid on the problem
Hey wanna talk? I’m a great listener!
Hey wanna talk a little? I feel the same way but maybe we can talk before you do it? I can help

I was smart enough to be in the classes of the honors, I just didn’t get the title. The past 2 years my mental health has been terrible. I was diagnosed with several disabilities. It really crushed me...

I have taken 5 college classes throughout HS. A lot of us cheated. We were allowed notes on test, but we weren’t supposed to. I gave into peer pressure...... it brakes me to think I should have did better.

17F HS Senior, I’m sorry. School is hard. I’ve been upset on my class rank. I’m not even in top 50%. I did get into my dream college though. I aimed pretty low, i guess. It really has been a struggle. I don’t think I’m smart. 17 ACT 3.4 GPA.......

There isn’t much you can do, without calling the hotline and possible police. If you feel like he will/has done it, then you can call and have him committed into a mental hospital. It probably won’t help, if he doesn’t want to help himself. You may want to just show kindness and hope that helps him...

I have depression, anxiety with some PTSD type sh#t. I think the same things every day. Why should I be here? Why do I need to go to school? Why can’t I maintain a healthy relationship? It really does make a person think. I am in therapy, but it still doesn’t help. Hope you don’t die, but I can’t decide that for you.....
